nodes.bdb: Jabbok = "emptying" a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea

nodes.g: Sion = "lofty" another name for Mount Hermon
Zephon = "treasure" a son of Gad and progenitor of the family of Zephonites
